verdict.rationale: Alloy is a KYC/AML and fraud-decisioning platform, so configurable customer risk scoring is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence never documents configurable customer risk factors, a risk score, or any explanation of why a score changed. The closest items are adjacent features: workflows that "apply policy logic," evaluation results returned in an evaluations[] array, and a services object showing vendor execution status. None of these is a risk-factor configuration or a score-change explanation.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure customer risk factors and inspect why the risk score changed
